title: Article 47 — Duty of the State to raise the level of nutrition and the standard of living and to improve public health

content.overview: Article 47 directs the State to regard the raising of the level of nutrition and the standard of living of its people and the improvement of public health as among its primary duties, and in particular to endeavour to bring about prohibition of the consumption except for medicinal purposes of intoxicating drinks and of drugs which are injurious to health.
content.glance: Primary duties: raise nutrition and standard of living; improve public health; endeavour to prohibit injurious intoxicating drinks and drugs (except medicinal).
content.study:
Article 47 elevates nutrition, standard of living and public health to primary State duties, and specifically addresses prohibition of injurious intoxicants (except for medicinal purposes).

Examination: primary duties; nutrition; standard of living; public health; prohibition endeavour.

sections.heading: Key directive
sections.body: Raise level of nutrition and standard of living; improve public health (primary duties); endeavour to prohibit consumption of injurious intoxicating drinks and drugs except for medicinal purposes.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 47 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 47 directs the State to regard the raising of the level of nutrition and the standard of living of its people and the improvement of public health as among its primary duties, and in particular to endeavour to bring about prohibition of the consumption, except for medicinal purposes, of intoxicating drinks and of drugs which are injurious to health.

examTips: Nutrition, standard of living, public health as primary duties; prohibition endeavour.

keyTakeaways: Art 47: nutrition, living standard, public health; prohibition endeavour.
